gates.title: Desktop micro-library browsing and playback controls
gates.next_evidence: Current app code at b03c592 passed the offline gate, app bundle build/signature and 15/15 injected AudioQueue cases. Runtime verification reached Player, Library, Queue and Playlists. With an existing CLI child present and playback finished, Cmd-Q was followed by disappearance of the prior app/child; relaunch was Ready/No Track with no playback child, so startup did not autoplay or scan. Two direct 0/1/100/2k/20k catalog profiles passed; 20k build took 519/636 ms and search p95 was 734/802 µs. Peak RSS and repeatable cold startup/incremental memory remain unmeasured. On 2026-10-31 the standalone app showed the generated silent WAV playing through macOS AudioQueue; after foreground Cmd-Q, Activity Monitor no longer showed app PID 11612 or CLI PID 11664 and cua.listApps reported isRunning=false. This verifies GUI child cleanup during synthetic silent playback, not audible playback or device recovery. After confirming the app was stopped, five fresh-process launches via `cua.getApp()` took 891, 858, 753, 798 and 779 ms. Each showed Ready / No Track with no scan or autoplay, and `listApps` confirmed the app stopped before the next launch. Median was 798 ms (range 753–891 ms). These are five fresh-process app launches, not system-boot cold starts or a threshold result. Separately, one idle Activity Monitor Memory view showed app PID 12236 at `anonymousMemory` 28.2 MB with no CLI child; this is one anonymous-memory sample, not RSS. After Cmd-Q and refresh, `listApps` reported `isRunning=false` and Activity Monitor had no app/CLI rows. Device disconnect/recovery, live Rust Boy shared focus, and physical DAC/panel acceptance remain open.

tasks.title: Implement WavPack only in verified lossless modes
tasks.acceptance: Own WavPack codec with independent parity; hybrid mode rejected without validated correction data
tasks.blocker: Generated FFmpeg 9.0.2 PCM parity passes for 882-frame mono and joint-stereo one-block streams; 4,410-frame mono, mixed joint/true-stereo, all-true-stereo, and deterministic pseudorandom 16-bit stereo multiblock streams; padded-24-bit mono/stereo streams with exact INT32_INFO [0,8,0,0]; and a high-entropy padded-24-bit stereo stream covering signed extrema. Independent WavPack Tiny Encoder 4.40 fast-mode vectors pass exact packed-16/24-bit high-entropy stereo PCM parity; default-, high- and very-high-quality-mode 20,000-frame packed-16-bit stereo streams also pass exact parity; the high-mode terms [18,18,18,-2,2,3,5,-1,17,4] extend support to cross-channel terms -2/-1 and lag predictors 2–5. A deterministic synthetic 1,063,147-frame packed-24-bit stereo stream passes exact parity against its generated PCM golden and FFmpeg decode; this does not establish compatibility with native real-world WavPack files. Supporting packed-24-bit resolves the observed 3-byte sample layout; known optional metadata is skipped while unknown mandatory metadata still fails closed. Decoded block checksums pass. Removing the unsupported ±1024 clamp on positive-term adaptive weights restored exact stereo parity; the bounded 24-bit path checksums reconstructed PCM before validating its 24-bit range. Encoded-block checksum tests reject bit flips and missing declared metadata. Native real-world WavPack source files, further independent-encoder parity, predictor terms other than -2/-1/2/3/4/5/17/18, other integer layouts/depths, trailing tags, and validated hybrid .wvc pairing remain. Keep WavPack unregistered and unadmitted.

tasks.title: Build zero-artwork micro media library experience
tasks.acceptance: For the macOS v1 workflow, provide explicit-root browsing, stable root-scoped IDs, bounded metadata/search, deterministic sorting, named persistent playlists, persistent queue, repeat/shuffle, and real Play/Pause/Resume/Stop/Next/Previous plus bounded volume in the standalone app. Queue selection never plays. Keep user audio read-only and skip image payloads without allocation; add no artwork/image extraction/cache/visualizers or third-party runtime dependencies. Benchmark scan/search at 0/1/100/2k/20k; record cold startup and incremental memory. Optional autoplay and native bypassable 10-band EQ remain separately gated follow-on work unless implemented and independently verified.
tasks.blocker: At code commit 7c1b1d0ba795a8af6cd0ff36bb55abf3fd087bcc, stable root-scoped IDs, bounded catalog/search, cancellable explicit scanning, persistent queue/repeat/shuffle, named playlists, and the text-only standalone workflow are implemented. Previous rebuilt-app checks covered library/search/queue/playlist persistence across restart, explicit Play/Pause/Resume/Stop/Next/Previous/volume, no autoplay, and operator-reported audible synthetic output. The full offline gate passed at 7c1b1d0 (17 local crates, 32 path-only edges, zero registry/Git crates); focused macOS CLI tests passed 19/19 unit plus 7/7 subprocess; app bundle build, plist lint, and strict local signature passed. Compact bounded UTF-8 metadata spans and CLI accessors passed independent read-only review. Three synthetic 20k before/after process-RSS profiles measured median deltas of 5,248 KiB with no tags, 5,568 KiB with 10% tagged, and 7,824 KiB with all tagged, below the 8,192 KiB target. RSS is an OS-observed estimate, not exact heap or full-app incremental memory; fixtures have bounded FLAC comments but no frames. The public pre-release Track.tags type and TrackTags fields changed to compact storage/accessors; in-workspace consumers were migrated. Active-playback SIGKILL evidence at a40758d showed app PID 16381 and CLI child PID 16556 both exited within 8 seconds, but device disconnect/recovery, physical DAC/panel, Rust Boy shared focus, app-wide memory, cold system startup, and transition latency remain open. Multiple-root reconciliation and non-Unix persistent queue behavior also remain. Existing codec parity evidence is retained; private media was not rerun. At 2026-10-31 UI source commit d65efc16f5e694ba40acdac6b4662ae94542b88d, the exact bundle passed host LaunchServices open (exit 0), showed Ready / No Track, and the packaged RBPK lifecycle smoke passed (exit 0). A generated 2,000-entry explicit app scan loaded with playback stopped; a single-match search was observed. App-wide incremental RSS remains unqualified because the same-process RSS fell from a 96,384 KiB idle median to 69,440 KiB after scanning, consistent with page reclamation. Device disconnect/recovery, physical DAC/panel, and live Rust Boy focus remain open. Keep RM-020 in progress and PR #1 draft.
